Activity patterns: detections per recorded hour

Source: R/07_activity.R
pam_activity.Rd

Counts the cleaned detections of each species in every hour of the day, day, week or month, and divides them by the time that was recorded in that period. Because the division uses recording effort, periods and sites that were recorded for different lengths of time can be compared. Use it for daily (diel) activity patterns and for seasonal patterns such as migration or breeding timing.

Usage

pam_activity(
  cfg,
  run_id = cfg$birdnet$run_id,
  by = c("hour", "day", "week", "month"),
  by_site = FALSE,
  species = NULL,
  thresholds = NULL,
  min_effort_hours = 0,
  write = FALSE
)

Arguments

cfg

A pam_config object.

run_id

Detection run (sub-folder of paths$detections).

by

The period: "hour" (hour of the day, pooled over all dates), "day", "week" (weeks start on Monday) or "month".

by_site

If FALSE (the default), sites are pooled: the rate is all detections divided by all recorded hours. If TRUE, one row per site.

species

Optional species to keep: scientific names, common names or species labels, in any capitalization. NULL keeps all.

thresholds

Optional per-species thresholds (a data frame, or the path of a CSV file, with scientific_name and threshold), for example from pam_species_thresholds(). They are applied on top of Stage 4 and can only remove more events.

min_effort_hours

Periods with less recorded time than this get no rate (NA) and sufficient = FALSE. Default 0 keeps every period with any recording.

write

If TRUE, also save the table as <outputs>/<run_id>/activity_<by>.csv. Nothing is written by default.

Value

A data.table with one row per period and species (and per site when by_site = TRUE): period (hour 0-23, or the first day of the period), species, scientific_name, n_detections, effort_hours, detections_per_hour, relative_activity (the rate divided by the species' highest rate, so 1 marks its peak), sufficient and, for pooled tables, n_sites_surveyed and n_sites_detected. Periods with recordings but no detection get 0. Periods with no recording have no row. The choices are stored in the attributes by and by_site.

Details

What the rate means

detections_per_hour is the number of detected events (Stage 4 merges overlapping BirdNET windows into events) per hour of recording. It is an activity index: it depends on how often and how loudly animals call, not only on how many are present, and on the confidence thresholds used. Compare it between periods and sites for the same species, and avoid comparing raw rates between species.

Time of day

Hours are local clock hours of the project time zone. A recording is split over the hours it covers, so effort is exact for recordings that start part way through an hour or cross midnight.

See also

pam_plot_activity(), pam_detection_table()

Examples

ex <- pam_example_project()
# the later stages read the master table that the scan builds
res <- suppressMessages(pam_scan_audio(ex$cfg))
proc <- suppressMessages(pam_process_detections(ex$cfg))
act <- suppressMessages(pam_activity(ex$cfg, by = "hour"))
as.data.frame(act)[, c("period", "species", "n_detections", "detections_per_hour")]
#>   period                                    species n_detections
#> 1      6  Ducula nicobarica_Nicobar Imperial-Pigeon            2
#> 2     18  Ducula nicobarica_Nicobar Imperial-Pigeon            2
#> 3      6         Gracula religiosa_Common Hill Myna            1
#> 4     18         Gracula religiosa_Common Hill Myna            0
#> 5      6 Psittacula longicauda_Long-tailed Parakeet            2
#> 6     18 Psittacula longicauda_Long-tailed Parakeet            3
#>   detections_per_hour
#> 1                1200
#> 2                1200
#> 3                 600
#> 4                   0
#> 5                1200
#> 6                1800
# one row per site and day
day <- suppressMessages(pam_activity(ex$cfg, by = "day", by_site = TRUE))
head(as.data.frame(day)[, c("site_id", "period", "species", "n_detections")], 4)
#>   site_id     period                                    species n_detections
#> 1   G0059 2026-04-05  Ducula nicobarica_Nicobar Imperial-Pigeon            2
#> 2   G0059 2026-04-05         Gracula religiosa_Common Hill Myna            0
#> 3   G0059 2026-04-05 Psittacula longicauda_Long-tailed Parakeet            3
#> 4   G0110 2026-04-06  Ducula nicobarica_Nicobar Imperial-Pigeon            2
